name: Government Service Home - Tamil Nadu
benefit: The beneficiary is provided accommodation, Food, Education, Vocational training, Free supply of textbooks, notebooks, uniforms, chappals, and sanitary napkins.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a female. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹ 72,000/- (not applicable for differently abled). 1. The age of the applicant should be between 14 to 45 years. 1. The applicant should qualify as one of the following: - Widow. - Destitute Woman. - Deserted Woman. - Adolescent Girl. - Differently Abled Woman. - Woman from Socially and Economically Backward Sections.
**NOTE: The women can stay with their male child up to 5th standard and girl child up to 12th standard in the Service Home.**
